correctness.rationale: Orthogonal projectors onto constants, part-constant mean-zero vectors and within-part fluctuations give all entries. Cross-part/diagonal entries have a fixed positive sign, so negative within-part rows determine the exact norm and positivity criterion. F(x,u) has precisely one nonzero time root; its curvature as a function of x forces strict root ordering, implying largest-part control. Limits x→0 and x→1 prove the stated two rates. The separately built finite-matrix checker passed 43,847 comparisons for 82 graph designs. Boundary cases t=0, singleton parts and n=2 were treated explicitly.

value.rationale: The exact entrywise positivity cutoff is a natural, sharp order-preservation and endpoint-contractivity invariant for the graph bi-heat semigroup. Dependence on only the largest part is structural information beyond the spectrum, and the pair of extremes with identical short-time norm slopes but distinct n^{-1} versus n^{-2} recovery times exposes a meaningful instability/timescale distinction. No paper-sized downstream theorem is necessary for this exact family classification.
